dialogue.content: こんばんは。よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: Good evening. Thank you for your time.

dialogue.content: (本日はよろしくお願いいたします。）
dialogue.English: (Thank you for your time today.)

dialogue.content: こんばんは、相談員です。年齢、性別、ご相談内容をお聞かせください。
dialogue.English: Good evening, I'm the counselor. Could you please tell me your age, gender, and the nature of your concern?

dialogue.content: 52歳、男性、娘の不登校に関する相談です
dialogue.English: I’m 52, male, and I’d like to discuss my daughter’s school refusal.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。それはご心配ですよね・・
dialogue.English: I see. That must be very worrying for you.

dialogue.content: ええ、今年の頭くらいから学校に行けなくなり、なんとか高2にはなったものの今も行けてません。
dialogue.English: Yes, she stopped being able to go to school around the beginning of this year. She somehow managed to advance to the second year of high school, but she still can't go.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。それは不安ですよね。何かきっかけのようなことはあったんでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. That must make you anxious. Was there anything that might have triggered this?

dialogue.content: なんか学校に馴染めないというか人からいろいろ言われたみたいですいじめではないようなのですが
dialogue.English: She hasn’t really been able to fit in at school, and it seems people have said various things to her. It doesn’t seem to be bullying, though.

dialogue.content: ええ、そうあったんですね・・今は学校に行っていないとのことですがお嬢さんはどのような過ごしていますか？
dialogue.English: I see, so that's what happened. You mentioned she's not going to school now; how is your daughter spending her days?

dialogue.content: 家で寝てますたまにスマホでゲームしたりそんな感じです
dialogue.English: She's at home sleeping. Sometimes she plays games on her phone, things like that.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。学校での出来事をご家族ではどのようにお話していますか？
dialogue.English: I understand. How do you talk as a family about what happened at school?

dialogue.content: 学校の出来事自体はあまり話しません電車で学校に行くのですが、電車に乗るとお腹が痛くなったり、気分が悪くなったりするようになりました
dialogue.English: We don't really talk about what happened at school itself. She takes the train to school, but she started getting stomachaches and feeling sick when she gets on the train.

dialogue.content: 学校が合わなかったのかなあという感じの話は妻としています
dialogue.English: My wife and I have talked about how maybe the school just wasn't a good fit for her.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね・・それはしんどい思いをされていたのですね・・大切はお嬢さんのことなので色々ご心配だと思います。今、どのようなことが一番心配でしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see... She must have been going through a very difficult time. I can imagine you have many concerns about your precious daughter. What is your biggest worry right now?

dialogue.content: 出席日数がそろそろリミットになり、このままでは留年ですまた寝てばかりいるのでそれも心配です
dialogue.English: Her attendance is nearing the limit, and at this rate, she’ll have to repeat the year. I’m also worried because she just sleeps all the time.

dialogue.content: ええ、寝てばかりいるのもご心配ですよね・・体調面や留年等を含めて奥様とはどのようなお話をされていますか・・？
dialogue.English: Yes, it’s understandable to be concerned about her sleeping so much. Including her health and the possibility of repeating the year, what kinds of conversations have you had with your wife?

dialogue.content: 元気になる方法は見つからない感じです留年は避けたいので、通信の高校への転校の話を考え出しました
dialogue.English: We can't seem to find a way for her to get better. We want to avoid her repeating the year, so we've started thinking about transferring to a correspondence high school.

dialogue.content: 心療内科に行って薬ももらったのですがだめですね
dialogue.English: We took her to a psychosomatic clinic and got some medication, but it hasn't helped.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。お父様がこちらにご相談に来ているので、とてもお嬢さん思いのお父様だと思います。お父様からみてお嬢様はどんなお子さんでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. The fact that you've come here to talk tells me you're a very caring father. From your perspective, what kind of child is your daughter?

dialogue.content: 真面目すぎるところがあります。融通がきかないというかでも中学までは何も問題ありませんでした
dialogue.English: She can be a bit too serious. A bit inflexible, you could say. But she had no problems up through middle school.

dialogue.content: 高校の雰囲気に合わなかったんだと思います
dialogue.English: I think the atmosphere at her high school just didn't suit her.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。雰囲気が合わないと辛いですよね・・真面目なお嬢さんなんですね・・今後は留年を避けたいので、通信制を考えているのですね・・そのように先の事を考えておられています。
dialogue.English: I see. When the environment doesn’t fit, it can be tough. She sounds like a very earnest young woman. Going forward, you’d like to avoid her repeating the year, so you’re considering a correspondence program. You’re thinking ahead in that way.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: でも娘とは話が出来ていないのです
dialogue.English: But I haven't been able to talk to my daughter about it.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。お嬢さんとのコミニュケーションを取れないことが、今、お悩みになっていますか？
dialogue.English: I see. Is the difficulty in communicating with your daughter what's troubling you now?

dialogue.content: 元気がないことと話ができないことですね‥
dialogue.English: Yes—her lack of energy and the fact that we can’t talk.

dialogue.content: それはご心配ですよね・・元気なお顔が見たいですよね・・奥様とお嬢さんはコミニュケーションはどうでしょうか？一緒に出掛けたりとか・・
dialogue.English: That must be very worrying. You just want to see her looking happy and energetic again. How is the communication between your wife and your daughter? Do they go out together or anything?

dialogue.content: それもないですね。部屋に閉じこもっています。
dialogue.English: No, not that either. She stays shut in her room.

dialogue.content: そうあったんですね・・お嬢さんの元気のないのはお父様としても胸が苦しいですよね・・これまで色々試されたとは思いますが、、
dialogue.English: I see... It must be heartbreaking for you as a father to see your daughter without her energy. I imagine you've tried many things already...

dialogue.content: そうですね、最初にきつく言いすぎたところがあって何かいろいろ話をしようとすると、部屋に戻ってしまうようになって
dialogue.English: Yes, I was a bit too harsh with her at the beginning, so now whenever I try to talk to her about anything, she just goes back to her room.

dialogue.content: 妻も少し世間話をするくらいですね
dialogue.English: My wife only manages to make a little small talk with her.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね・・お父様としても心配でしたよね。仕事もある中でお父様が一生懸命なんとかしようとされていたのですね。お嬢さんのお気持ちの回復にはお時間がかかるのかもしれません・・その辺りはどのようにお考えでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see... You were worried, of course. You've been trying so hard to do something, all while managing your work. It might take some time for your daughter to recover emotionally. What are your thoughts on that?

dialogue.content: 学校に行きたい気持ちはあるものの行こうとしてもいけないみたいですそうすると転校の話をするしかないのですが
dialogue.English: It seems she has the desire to go to school, but she just can't bring herself to go. In that case, I feel like our only option is to talk about transferring.

dialogue.content: そう簡単には行けるようにはならないと思います
dialogue.English: I don't think she'll be able to start going again that easily.

dialogue.content: そうかもしれません・・お父様としては元気なお嬢さんに戻ってほしいとお考えとお話ししてくれました。どうしたらそのような状態に戻っていけると思われますか？
dialogue.English: That may be the case. You mentioned that as her father, you want her to go back to being her energetic self. What do you think it would take for her to return to that state?

dialogue.content: 自分に合った学校に変わるのが一番いいのではないかと思います今の学校にこだわっていると元気にならないと思います
dialogue.English: I think changing to a school that suits her would be the best thing. I don't think she'll get better if we insist on her staying at her current school.

dialogue.content: そのようにお考えなんですね・・そこまで理解してくれるお父様がいてくれて、お嬢さんも幸せだと思います。学校を変えるにも、そのようなお話をできるようになるには、お嬢様にどのような対応をされるのがいいのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: So that's what you're thinking. Your daughter is fortunate to have a father who understands her so well. To be able to have that conversation about changing schools, what kind of approach do you think would be best with her?

dialogue.content: そうですね、なんとかうまく転校の話をしたいですね
dialogue.English: You're right, I want to find a good way to bring up the topic of transferring.

dialogue.content: 話ができるような方法を考えないといけないですね
dialogue.English: I need to think of a way to make it possible for us to talk.

dialogue.content: 何かいい方法ありますかね？
dialogue.English: Do you have any good suggestions?

dialogue.content: ええ、そうなんですね・・転校はいいお考えなのかもしれませんが、お嬢さんはどう思われているのでしょうか？お嬢さんの心の回復には今どのようなことが必要だとお考えでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Yes, I understand. Transferring might be a good idea, but I wonder what your daughter thinks about it. What do you think she needs right now for her emotional recovery?

dialogue.content: 時間は必要だと思いますが、誰か話し相手ができるといいとは思います
dialogue.English: I think she needs time, but it would also be good if she had someone she could talk to.

dialogue.content: 転校は最初は嫌がるでしょうね。
dialogue.English: She'll probably resist the idea of transferring at first.

dialogue.content: 一応今の学校にも友達はいるようなので
dialogue.English: It seems she does have friends at her current school, at least.

dialogue.content: でも電車乗れないからなあ
dialogue.English: But she can’t ride the train...

dialogue.content: ええ、そうですね。まずはお部屋から出てきてコミニュケーションがとれうようになるのがいいのかなと思いますが、それには転校の話を出すまでにはお嬢さんの気持ちの回復は先にするのはどう思いますか？
dialogue.English: Yes, that's true. I think it might be good to first focus on helping her come out of her room and communicate. What do you think about prioritizing her emotional recovery before bringing up the topic of transferring schools?

dialogue.content: 例えば、お友達に家に来てもらうとか・・どうですか？
dialogue.English: For example, having a friend come over to the house... What do you think?

dialogue.content: そんなにすぐには回復するようには思えないんですよね友達は確かに一つの手ですが
dialogue.English: I don't think she'll recover that quickly. Having friends over is certainly one option, though.

dialogue.content: そうお考えなんですね・・スクールカウンセラーや先生などにご相談はされましたか？
dialogue.English: I understand. Have you consulted with the school counselor or her teachers?

dialogue.content: 本人も留年はしたくないと思いますしスクールカウンセラーや先生とも話はしましたが、これといっていい方向には向かってないですね
dialogue.English: I think she herself doesn’t want to repeat the year, and we’ve spoken with the school counselor and her teachers, but things haven’t really moved in a good direction.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね・・色々試されてきたのですよね。こんなにもお父様に愛されているので、お父様の優しいお気持ちで少しづつ回復をしていけるといいのですが、お父様としても少しお時間がかかるとお考えですので・・お嬢さんと一緒に楽しい時間を過ごせるといいのですが。。
dialogue.English: I see... You’ve tried many things. Given how much you love your daughter, I hope your gentle support will help her recover little by little. Since you also feel it may take some time, it would be nice if you could spend some enjoyable time together with her.

dialogue.content: そうですねありがとうございますでも一度話をできるようにトライしてみます転校の話も加えて
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you. I’ll try to have a conversation with her, and I'll include the topic of transferring.

dialogue.content: 何がいいのか娘と一緒に考える場を持ってみますね
dialogue.English: I'll try to create a space to think together with my daughter about what would be best.

dialogue.content: そうお考えなんですね。お嬢さんの学校のことでご相談にきてくれました。お嬢さんが元気になるように一緒に考える場所を作るとお気づきになったので、これからいい方向に進むと思います。
dialogue.English: I see that's what you're thinking. You came to consult about your daughter’s schooling. Since you’ve realized the importance of creating a space to think together about how she can regain her well-being, I believe things will move in a better direction from here.

dialogue.content: 今日はこれでご相談を終わりにしたいと思います。
dialogue.English: I’d like to conclude our session for today.

dialogue.content: 承知しましたありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Understood. Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: お疲れさまでした
dialogue.English: Thank you for your help.

dialogue.content: お話足りないこともあったかと思います。また、ご相談があった時にこちらにいらしていただけると嬉しいです・・
dialogue.English: I'm sure there are things we didn't have enough time to discuss. Please feel free to come back anytime you need to talk.

dialogue.content: 本日はありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you very much for today.

dialogue.content: はい、また相談させていただきます
dialogue.English: Yes, I’ll consult with you again.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: （本日はありがとうございました。終了メッセージ流します）
dialogue.English: (Thank you for today. Sending the closing message now.)
